findings.detail: Under the assumption: own:led-disk isn't placed once
findings.assumption: Each hole's centre is at the middle of where Dan's readings put it, 16.85 mm out.

findings.detail: Under the assumption: own:led-disk isn't placed once
findings.assumption: The disk's board is 1.6 mm thick, and each hole's centre is 16.85 mm out.

findings.detail: Under the assumption: no heat-set inserts
findings.assumption: An insert holds with at least 2.85 mm of plastic around it, and its post bulges with less.

findings.detail: Under the assumption: 0 keyhole(s) found in the back, and this check reads only keyholes
findings.assumption: The wall screws' heads are 9 mm across, so a keyhole works if its entry passes a 9 mm head and its slot carries the head clear of the entry, in place of matching the one keyhole that hung (10.5 mm entry, 12 mm slot).
